scripts.dev:fresh: rm -rf node_modules .svelte-kit build && pnpm install && pnpm run monsan-ui:link && pnpm test && vite dev --host --force
scripts.monsan-ui:link: flock /tmp/monsan-ui-build.lock pnpm --dir ../MonsanUI run build:package && rm -rf node_modules/monsan-ui && ln -s ../../MonsanUI node_modules/monsan-ui
scripts.check: pnpm run paraglide:build && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.check:watch: pnpm run paraglide:build && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --watch
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run paraglide:build && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm standards && pnpm tooling && pnpm env:check && pnpm page-structure && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build
